verdict.rationale: Jitsu's own Functions feature processes data before it is sent to a destination, with documented Filter and Transform operations. This gives a general-purpose JavaScript hook through which sensitive attributes could be removed or modified per destination. No PII-specific hashing, masking, or field-level redaction controls are documented; the privacy lead would have to write custom code to get them. missing for 10: built-in hashing of PII fields, built-in masking/redaction, declarative field-level allow/deny lists per destination, PII-focused documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes

citations.quote: Filter - Exclude data that fails to meet your specified criteria. Transform - Modify data to fit the schema of your destination.
Functions are designed to process data in Jitsu before it is sent to the destination. These functions, written in JavaScript, provide various data handling options
